en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a large domed imperial building labeled "Kaiserpalast" in the background (the Kaiserpalast in Strasbourg). In the foreground is an equestrian statue of Kaiser Wilhelm I with rows of artillery pieces and soldiers marching with rifles and bayonets along the street. Handwritten script borders the image, and a large blue handwritten number "158" appears near the top.
